dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: There are worse ways to kill time than fairytales.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: The simple wording, the childlike wonder, the romanticism — it all makes for some nice easy reading that doesn't require any brainpower.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Well, until you start noticing some of the more uncomfortable parallels between fantasy and reality.
